records.new_gloss_en: relating to principles of right and wrong
records.linguistic_reason: Ethical can mean concerned with ethics or compliant with moral principles; context needed.

records.new_gloss_en: an authority that oversees compliance with rules
records.linguistic_reason: A device controlling pressure or voltage is a separate mechanical sense.

records.new_gloss_en: a worm with a slender unsegmented body
records.linguistic_reason: Nematode refers to the phylum of roundworms, including parasitic and free-living species.

records.new_gloss_en: to leave a place so that it becomes empty
records.linguistic_reason: Vacate also means resign an office or invalidate a court ruling.

records.new_gloss_en: to make something appear larger
records.linguistic_reason: Figurative exaggeration and physical enlargement differ.

records.new_gloss_en: an official instruction issued by an authority
records.linguistic_reason: Directive is also an adjective meaning guiding, so POS split necessary.

records.new_gloss_en: in terms of money or economic conditions
records.linguistic_reason: Meaning 'without waste' is an economy-of-means sense and should be split.

records.new_gloss_en: the use of living organisms or biological systems to develop products
records.linguistic_reason: Biotechnology covers applied biological processes in medicine, agriculture and industry.

records.new_gloss_en: a reduction in the rate of activity or growth
records.linguistic_reason: Slowdown is a noun indicating lower pace, not necessarily absolute decline.

records.new_gloss_en: unwilling to work or make an effort
records.linguistic_reason: Lazy can be judgmental; describing a low-effort method is a separate extension.

records.new_gloss_en: the final and often most important result of a process
records.linguistic_reason: Culmination implies a process reaching a peak or conclusion.

records.new_gloss_en: a substance used to change the color of material
records.linguistic_reason: Verb dye means to color something; separate part of speech.

records.new_gloss_en: a person employed to clean and manage a home
records.linguistic_reason: Housekeeper also denotes a hotel cleaning employee, related occupational use.

records.new_gloss_en: a repeated sharp rattling noise made by hard objects
records.linguistic_reason: Clatter functions as noun and verb; audit POS before activation.

records.new_gloss_en: the supporting frame of a vehicle or machine
records.linguistic_reason: Chassis denotes a structural base; plural chassis has unchanged spelling.

records.new_gloss_en: to change the shape or appearance of something unnaturally
records.linguistic_reason: Distort also means misrepresent information; distinct figurative usage.

records.new_gloss_en: a quantity measuring uncertainty or dispersion in a system
records.linguistic_reason: Thermodynamic and information entropy require domain-specific definitions; avoid treating as interchangeable.

records.old_gloss_zh: 主动积极的；预先采取行动的
records.new_gloss_en: acting in anticipation of future problems or needs
records.new_gloss_zh: 主动预防的；积极主动的
records.linguistic_reason: Proactive involves initiating action in advance rather than only reacting.

records.new_gloss_en: a person who climbs mountains or other steep surfaces
records.linguistic_reason: Climber can also mean a climbing plant or a worker who ascends structures.

records.new_gloss_en: to cause severe damage to the functioning of something
records.linguistic_reason: Cripple for a disabled person is offensive/dated; figurative verb needs explicit register QA.

records.new_gloss_en: a narrow light boat propelled by a paddle
records.linguistic_reason: Canoe as a verb means travel by canoe; nautical noun sense isolated.

records.new_gloss_en: a scholar who studies past societies through their material remains
records.linguistic_reason: Archaeologist studies artifacts and sites, not simply written history.

records.new_gloss_en: an electrical safety device that interrupts a circuit
records.linguistic_reason: Breaker also refers to machines that break material and ocean waves.

records.new_gloss_en: an opening through which fluid enters a device
records.linguistic_reason: Inlet can also mean a narrow arm of the sea; engineering and geography senses differ.

records.new_gloss_en: covered with or consisting of rocks
records.linguistic_reason: Rocky also describes troubled relationships or difficult periods.

records.new_gloss_en: a person trained to travel or work in space
records.linguistic_reason: Astronaut refers to spaceflight crew, with agency-specific titles varying.

records.new_gloss_en: long and thin in shape
records.linguistic_reason: Slender may describe people or a limited amount of resources.

records.old_gloss_zh: 明确无误的；不会认错的
records.new_gloss_en: so clear or distinctive that it cannot reasonably be mistaken
records.new_gloss_zh: 明确无误的；极易辨认的
records.linguistic_reason: Unmistakable emphasizes unmistakable identification or certainty.

records.new_gloss_en: a roadside post showing directions or locations
records.linguistic_reason: Signpost as verb or figurative indicator is a separate sense.

records.new_gloss_en: physically weak or lacking strength
records.linguistic_reason: Feeble also describes ineffective arguments or attempts.

records.new_gloss_en: having two parts or aspects
records.linguistic_reason: Twofold can also mean twice as much; distinct numerical sense.

records.new_gloss_en: a police officer of a particular rank
records.linguistic_reason: Constable rank and powers vary by jurisdiction.

records.new_gloss_en: to become less intense or severe
records.linguistic_reason: Abate may be transitive in legal contexts, but core intransitive meaning is coherent.

records.new_gloss_en: a person who regularly provides care to someone needing assistance
records.linguistic_reason: Caregiver may be paid or unpaid; unlike solely a family relative.

records.new_gloss_en: to remove someone from a position of power
records.linguistic_reason: Oust generally implies forceful or contested removal, not routine retirement.

records.new_gloss_en: to walk with a limp or difficulty
records.linguistic_reason: Hobble also means constrain movement or hinder activity.

records.new_gloss_en: using threats or force to make someone comply
records.linguistic_reason: Coercive implies pressure undermining voluntary choice, not merely persuasive.

records.new_gloss_en: a piece of absorbent cloth used for drying
records.linguistic_reason: Towel is a concrete noun; verb to towel is separate.

records.new_gloss_en: to calculate the product of numbers
records.linguistic_reason: Multiply also means increase in number or reproduce biologically.

records.new_gloss_en: a prepared strip of ground for aircraft to take off and land
records.linguistic_reason: Fashion catwalk and business cash runway are distinct uses.

records.new_gloss_en: to make someone feel annoyed
records.linguistic_reason: Irritate also describes physical inflammation or chemical stimulation.

records.new_gloss_en: to search thoroughly through an area
records.linguistic_reason: Scour also means scrub vigorously and erode by flowing water.

records.new_gloss_en: to teach a worker new or updated skills
records.linguistic_reason: Machine-learning model retraining is a technical extension.

records.new_gloss_en: relating to ocean tides
records.linguistic_reason: Tidal modifies flow, forces or cycles caused by tides.

records.new_gloss_en: the act of overseeing work or conduct
records.linguistic_reason: Supervision can include mentoring guidance, but oversight is central.

records.new_gloss_en: an official who investigates certain deaths
records.linguistic_reason: Coroner's legal powers and qualifications vary across jurisdictions.

records.new_gloss_en: to bend a part of the body or a material
records.linguistic_reason: Flex also means contract a muscle and informally show off.

records.new_gloss_en: a very large amount of something
records.linguistic_reason: Abundance denotes plentiful supply, not necessarily high quality.

records.new_gloss_en: a box used to hold a dead body for burial
records.linguistic_reason: Coffin is a burial container; regional terms vary from casket.

records.new_gloss_en: a group of people or vehicles traveling together
records.linguistic_reason: British caravan for a mobile vacation trailer is a separate sense.
